label: LineSentry edge gateway
info: Edge processing for LineSentry: window aggregation, EWMA smoothing and deadband filtering of raw sensor readings before they go to the cloud.

name: Window aggregate (10 s)
EWMA smoothing
Deadband filter
Raw MQTT in -> 10 s window (mean/min/max/rms) -> EWMA -> deadband -> linesentry/edge/... . Point the mqtt out at AWS IoT Core once the cloud side is up.
